item.text: [{"task_id":"f5aa3634","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['settings'][0]))","    repeats = int(round(params['settings'][1]))","    steps = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]","    height, width = grid.shape","    unseen = set((int(p[0]), int(p[1])) for p in np.argwhere(grid != bg))","    objects = []","    while unseen:","        start = unseen.pop()","        cells = [start]","        queue = [start]","        while queue:","            r, c = queue.pop()","            for dr, dc in steps:","                point = (r + dr, c + dc)","                if point in unseen:","                    unseen.remove(point)","                    cells.append(point)","                    queue.append(point)","        top = min(p[0] for p in cells)","        bottom = max(p[0] for p in cells)","        left = min(p[1] for p in cells)","        right = max(p[1] for p in cells)","        crop = grid[top:bottom + 1, left:right + 1].copy()","        objects.append(crop)","    for candidate in objects:","        matches = sum(other.shape == candidate.shape and np.all(other == candidate) for other in objects)","        if matches >= repeats:","            return candidate","    return grid.copy()"],"shapes":{"settings":[2],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"settings":[0,2],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Extract orthogonally connected non-background objects and return the tightly cropped object that occurs twice with identical shape and colors. Each demonstration contains exactly one duplicated object. Tensors specify the background, required repetition count, and connectivity."}]
